environment: Linux x86-64, Qt 6.8.2 Release (-O1), offscreen widgets
scope: Linux Qt Release, including selection via context menu, keyboard and mouse, file hover cards, rendering selected step statuses and help-search highlights.
native_x11_mouse: On a Qt xcb window, right-clicked the row and left-clicked both context commands. The checked set changed 0→1→0 without activating a record.

ui.help_search: Literal case-insensitive terms, multiple terms, no results, query edit or clear, article changes and history, independent page find, theme/language change and close/reopen.
ui.files: Native tooltips, literal markup and long paths; open versus checked record; single workflow-error marker; fixed name position and font color across selection.

not_run: Native Windows and macOS builds and desktop tests
